digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
propositions: Dual vocabulary (success criteria and acceptance criteria) in reviewer prompts creates ambiguity by pooling distinct headings under a single bar and is noise in the rubrics
The criteria guide is generated from reviewer prompts; renaming at source requires regeneration to eliminate the dual vocabulary from downstream documentation
Editing criteria_routing.json rotates the regver stamp, invalidating outstanding attestations as stale; this is now safe because ADR 0053 grandfathering (ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e) has merged

Success Criteria -> Acceptance Criteria renaming must exclude plan_review_T2.md (whose phrase is generic English about trial success metrics, not the ticket heading) and dod_uncertifiable wording in verifier prompts (tracked separately)
